newsitem.title: USA: Most US debt futures end down, bond at 2-week low.
newsitem.headline: Most US debt futures end down, bond at 2-week low.

text.p: U.S. debt futures ended mostly lower, with June Treasury bonds near a two-week low and December Eurodollars flat.
Traders cited technical weakness and disappointment that June lacked followthrough on an earlier bounce above 110-00.
June T-bonds broke through the bottom end of last week's range and touched 109-3/32.

June had started the session firm, only to be swatted down by one dealer's sales of 10,000 contracts in the first hour alone, traders said. Other dealers were also aggressive sellers of up to 2,000 contracts each.
That selling, coupled with robust U.S. trade data, caused June T-bonds to drift lower all session, traders said.

"It was a very disapppinting day," said Don Pullen, bond trading floor manager for ED and F Man. "We had weak technicals, and a weak settlement suggesting that we could see more technical pressure again tomorrow as we get closer to the holiday weekend."
Bond futures close early Friday at 1210 CDT/1710 GMT and Eurodollars close early at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT. Trade will be shut on Monday to observe Memorial Day.
Pullen said talk of hedge fund selling also plagued June.
He said 109-12/32 had been important support, and June touched off sellstops when it eroded through there.
Early in the day, it was robust trade data that first pulled June T-bonds into the 109-00 handle.

The U.S. March trade gap narrowed 19.3 percent to $8.51 billion from a revised $10.5 billion in February. Record overseas sales helped shrink the deficit, with U.S. exports up 4.1 percent from February.
The short end remained firm most of the day but was off from Tuesday's post-FOMC highs. The Fed left monetary policy unchanged after its open market committee meeting Tuesday.
A Eurodollar trader said trade was active during the first hour of pit trade, but was "pathetic" for the rest of the day.

At the close, June T-bonds were off 18/32 at 109-9/32, T-notes were down 6/32 at 107-05/32, muni-bonds fell 16/32 to 116-06/32, Sept T-bills rose 0.010 to 94.550, and December Eurodollars were flat at 93.735.
